title: Covering Cech complexes
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme. Work either on its small etale site with module sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], or on its small pro-etale site with module sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], in the size conventions of those nodes. Let $U$ be an object of the chosen site, $\mathcal V=\{f_a:V_a\to U\}_{a=1}^m$ a finite covering, and $M$ a module sheaf on that site. In forming the following complex use the underlying presheaf of abelian groups of $M$.

The covering Cech cochain complex is the complex of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] for this covering and this presheaf. Thus, for $p\geq0$, put

$$
\check C^p(\mathcal V,M)=\prod_{(a_0,\ldots,a_p)\in\{1,\ldots,m\}^{p+1}} M(V_{a_0}\times_U\cdots\times_U V_{a_p}),
$$

with all ordered tuples, including repetitions. For $0\leq j\leq p+1$, let $d_j$ be the projection from the fibre product indexed by $(a_0,\ldots,a_{p+1})$ to the product with its $j$-th factor omitted. The differential is

$$
(\delta^p s)_{a_0\ldots a_{p+1}}=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j M(d_j)(s_{a_0\ldots\widehat{a_j}\ldots a_{p+1}}).
$$

Terms in negative degrees are zero. Its cohomology is denoted

$$
\check H^p(\mathcal V,M)=H^p(\check C^\bullet(\mathcal V,M))=\ker\delta^p/\operatorname{im}\delta^{p-1}\quad(p\geq0),
$$

where $\operatorname{im}\delta^{-1}=0$. The augmentation is the restriction map

$$
\epsilon:M(U)\longrightarrow\check C^0(\mathcal V,M),\qquad s\longmapsto(M(f_a)(s))_{a=1}^m.
$$

The augmentation is additional to the nonnegative complex used to define $\check H^p$; equivalently it supplies the degree $-1$ map of the augmented complex. All products and cohomology above are taken in abelian groups. Restricting the coefficient sheaf to $U$ also makes these groups modules over its ring of sections on $U$.

lean.statement: def etaleCoverCechComplex (T : Scheme.{u}) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} {U : T.Etale} (V : Fin m → T.Etale) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U) (_hcover : Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows V f) ∈ T.smallEtaleTopology U) (S : SiteCechComplex V f) (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology RingCat.{u + 1}).obj (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1, u} R)))) : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℤ
lean.note: Both coefficient-site specializations reuse SiteCechComplex on M.val.presheaf, with no second Cech complex construction. The owning module supplies the actual restriction augmentation and the scalar action induced on cohomology by restriction-scalar cochain maps. Product choices are explicit SiteCechComplex data with universal properties, as required by the recorded dependency interface. The three postponed verification theorems express the augmentation and module-action clauses of this definition.
